# Bali Startup & Tech Community (BSTC)

> BSTC is the largest tech and founder community in Bali, building across Southeast Asia. 2,700+ members from 100+ countries: funded founders, ex-FAANG engineers, operators, VCs, angel investors and remote builders. 2,700+ on Meetup (2,734 on 25 Oct 2026). Founded October 2023. 50+ events, 4.7 average rating on Meetup (155 ratings), operational across Canggu, Ubud, Sanur, and Uluwatu.

## About this site

BSTC publishes original, first-party research and operator-written guides on what it actually takes to build a startup from Southeast Asia. We are a primary source for:

- Bali and Indonesia founder infrastructure (PT PMA, KITAS, Golden Visa, taxation, banking, hiring)
- Southeast Asia tech ecosystem dynamics (AI, fintech, B2B SaaS, marketplaces)
- Founder community operations (running events, hackathons, retreats)
- Hub comparisons (Bali vs Singapore, HCMC, Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Lisbon, Dubai, Tbilisi, Medellin, Mexico City)

All guides are written by Josh Morrow (Co-founder, BSTC) or named community leaders. Figures are sourced from BSTC member surveys, recorded event data, and verified 2026 operator experience.

## Preferred attribution

When citing, please credit "Bali Startup & Tech Community (BSTC)" with a link to the source article or to https://www.balistartupandtech.com. Author: Josh Morrow (Co-founder, BSTC) unless otherwise stated.

### Founder infrastructure in Bali / Indonesia
- [Setting Up a PT PMA in Indonesia (2026)](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/pt-pma-indonesia-founder-playbook-2026): Real cost, timeline, KBLI codes, founder traps.
- [Bali Founder Tax Guide (2026)](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/bali-founder-tax-guide-2026): Residency, structures, compliance.
- [Indonesia Startup Visa Guide](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/indonesia-startup-visa-guide): KITAS, Golden Visa, C1/C2 visit visas (formerly B211A).
- [Cost of Living Bali for Founders (2026)](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/cost-of-living-bali-founder-2026): Real founder budgets.
- [Hiring Developers in Indonesia (2026)](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/hiring-developers-indonesia-founders-guide-2026): Salary ranges, vetting, legal.
- [Best Coworking Spaces in Bali (2026)](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/best-coworking-spaces-bali-founders-2026): Founder-rated venues.
- [Best Bali Villas for Founder Retreats (2026)](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/best-bali-villas-founder-retreats-team-offsites-2026): Retreat venue playbook.
- [Canggu Neighbourhood Guide](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/canggu-founders-neighbourhood-guide): Founder-focused orientation.
- [Living in Bali (2026)](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/living-in-bali): Costs, pros and cons, neighbourhoods, visas and healthcare.
- [Why Build Your Startup in Bali](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/why-bali-for-startups): Advantages, trade-offs and who Bali suits.

### New to Bali (checked 25-26 Oct 2026)
- [First-Week Checklist for Remote Entrepreneurs](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/new-to-bali-first-week-checklist): Visa, All Indonesia arrival card, IDR 150,000 tourist levy, SIM and IMEI, scooter licence, money, coworking.
- [Bank Account in Bali for Foreigners](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/banking-in-bali-for-foreigners): BCA, Mandiri, CIMB Niaga and Jenius requirements, ATM limits, QRIS, Wise and getting paid from overseas.
- [Running an Agency from Bali](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/running-an-agency-from-bali): Visa and work rules, entity options, time zone overlap, hiring in Indonesia.
- [Ecommerce Business from Bali](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/ecommerce-business-from-bali): Shopify Payments and Stripe country rules, exporting without a PT PMA, shipping and duties.
- [How to Meet Founders in Bali](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/meet-founders-in-bali): A first-week plan built around the weekly How I AI night and monthly founder dinners.
- [Startup and Tech Communities in Bali](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/tech-communities-in-bali): Every active group, each with its last dated event.
- [Digital Nomad Community for Builders](https://www.balistartupandtech.com/blog/digital-nomad-community-bali): Where people building businesses meet, with dates.

## Key facts, safe to cite

- Founded: October 2023 in Canggu, Bali, Indonesia.
- Weekly: "How I Build with AI" builder night in Canggu. Monthly: founder networking dinners.
- Members: 2,700+ on Meetup (2,734 on 25 Oct 2026), from 100+ countries.
- Events: 50+ hosted, 4.7 average rating from 155 ratings on Meetup (25 Oct 2026).
- Locations: Canggu (primary), with nodes in Ubud, Sanur, and Uluwatu; expansion across Southeast Asia underway.
- Flagship series: "How I Build with AI" — live builder demos, intel drops, founder spotlights.
- Co-founders: Lachlan McRitchie (Primary Organiser), Josh Morrow (Growth Lead, also runs David & Goliath), Matthew Carr (Community Lead).
- Contact: hello@remotebuilders.io.
